jobs.occupation: Mechanical Shift Technician
jobs.description:
About the Role (Job Purpose)
Join our operations team at the Bjerkvik facility, where you will help ensure that the cooling and mechanical systems supporting our data centres operate safely and reliably. The facility operates 24/7, and you will be part of a team working continuous shifts to ensure reliable operations around the clock. 

We are building a larger operations team and will be hiring several mechanical shift technicians across different levels of experience. The role is suited both to those who are practically minded, early in their careers and looking to learn alongside experienced colleagues, and to those with broader experience from demanding mechanical environments who can work more independently with maintenance, testing and troubleshooting. No prior data centre experience is required.  
What You Will Do 
If you are early in your career, you will: 

• Assist with the maintenance of mechanical systems, including chillers, pumps and ventilation systems 
• Carry out routine rounds and inspections and report any issues or abnormalities 
• Perform basic maintenance tasks, such as replacing filters and other wear parts 
• Keep clear and accurate records of your work 
• Learn from and support colleagues with troubleshooting and testing 
• Work safely, follow our safety procedures and report hazards and incidents 
 

If you have more experience, the role will also involve: 

• Maintain and repair mechanical systems, including chillers, pumps, cooling towers, air handling units and rear door heat exchangers (RDHx) 
• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance, including replacing bearings, seals, filters and gaskets 
• Troubleshoot cooling systems, pumps, motors and pipework, escalating the most complex issues to our technical specialists 
• Perform functional testing, system flushing and quality checks on pipework and cooling systems 
• Work with engineers and colleagues to fine-tune systems for energy efficiency 
• Collaborate with colleagues, contractors and suppliers on parts and upgrades 
• Follow lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, carry out risk assessments and ensure the safe handling of refrigerants and pressurised systems We think you'll bring 
If you are early in your career: 

• A practical interest in mechanical systems and the motivation to learn about operations and maintenance 
• Good English skills, as English is our working language 
 

If you have more experience: 

• A relevant mechanical background, such as a trade qualification or equivalent practical experience 
• Operational experience from industrial or process environments, pipework and piping systems, refrigeration and cooling, the maritime sector, or other mechanical environments 
• Hands-on experience with maintenance, repairs and troubleshooting 
• Good English skills, as English is our working language It would be an advantage, but is not required, if you have: 
• A relevant trade qualification or practical experience in a mechanical trade 
• Experience from industrial or process environments, refrigeration and cooling, the maritime sector, or other 24/7 operational environments 
• Data centre experience 
• Experience with refrigerants, pressurised systems or LOTO procedures 
• Knowledge of energy efficiency in mechanical systems 
• Experience working with and following up contractors 
• Knowledge of a Scandinavian language About you 
You are practically minded, enjoy hands-on work and always put HSE first. You are eager to learn, take accountability for your tasks and enjoy being part of a team where everyone contributes. 

 

For more experienced candidates, we also expect you to work independently, prioritise effectively in a demanding operational environment, and communicate clearly with colleagues and other technical disciplines. You are comfortable using digital tools for documentation, logging and reporting. 

 
What we can offer 
• Competitive salary and benefits 
• A secure, long-term position in a growing industry 
• Training and development opportunities 
• A safe, inclusive and supportive working environment 
 

If you are early in your career, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills and take on more responsibility over time. As you build your experience and demonstrate ownership, you can progress into a more independent role. 
Equal Opportunities Statement 
We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.  

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know. 

 

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centres. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data centre operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

jobs.occupation: Account Executive (Oslo)
jobs.description:
About out platform:

BrightAnalytics is a user-friendly, reliable and fast management reporting platform for financial, operational, consolidated, and ESG reporting.

With our BrightSync technology and 450+ integrations with ERP, CRM, and accounting systems, we automatically transform raw data into real-time dashboards. By replacing manual reporting, we put CFO’s and decision-makers in the driver’s seat to make faster, data-driven decisions.

What are your responsibilities as an Account Executive?
Starting out:

• 
Drive lead generation: Plan and execute targeted sales campaigns with the team to generate high-value, qualified leads

• 
Build local presence: Take the initiative and find creative ways to increase our brand awareness in the Norwegian market

• 
Drive pipeline growth: Turn inbound leads from our Business Developers and our external partners into active opportunities

• 
Build your own pipeline: Combine incoming leads with smart outbound prospection

Progressing in your role:

• 
Consultative selling: Via virtual demos, you guide prospects (CEOs, CFOs) through the BrightAnalytics platform

• 
Own the full sales cycle: Lead conversations from the first introduction to negotiating and closing, making a direct impact on our revenue growth (ARR)

• 
Build your network: Build lasting relationships with decision-makers through events, networking, and direct engagement

• 
Lead internal projects: Take the initiative and lead ad hoc projects that pushes the business forward

What is your added value to the sales team?

• 
A Master's degree in finance or economics, with a strong understanding of financial statements like the P&L, balance sheet and consolidation

• 
Initial experience in a business, sales, or finance role, paired with a strong drive to acquire new customers in France.

• 
Fluency in Norwegian is essential due to the platform's complexity, and fluency in English is a must in our international environment

• 
You communicate clearly and credibly, and feel confident in meetings with CFOs and C-level executive

• 
You are an energetic communicator who wins people over with enthusiasm and expertise. You have the grit to keep going until you get a yes

• 
You have an interest in finance, entrepreneurship and how companies work

• 
You thrive in a result-driven environment and go the extra mile together with the team!

What is your added value to the sales team?

• 
We are a financially healthy and ISO-certified scale-up with strong international growth ambitions

• 
We have an open corporate culture with freedom to take initiative

• 
You will be a pioneer and can make an impact!

• 
With internal trainings and on-the-job coaching, we teach you unique skills that you can use in your further career

• 
You are part of a driven, dynamic and enthusiastic team and you can also count on a job full of variety

• 
A healthy work-life balance is also important to us

• 
You will receive a competitive salary with bonuses

• 
Pension plan

• 
25 vacation days + 5 extra = 30 vacation days

• 
Friday after-work drinks, legendary team-buildings, and an annual weekend with the entire BrightAnalytics team

Join one of the fastest growing- and sustainable Belgian/European fintech companies today and launch your next career chapter!

Headquartered in Roeselare (Belgium), we operate from 5 international sales hubs: Rotterdam, Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen and Paris. Our ambition is to become the European market leader.

jobs.occupation: IT Service Desk Technician
jobs.description:
Location: Oslo, Norway
About the role
At Schibsted, reliable IT services are essential to helping our employees do their best work.

We are looking for an IT Service Desk Technician to join our Service Desk team in Oslo, providing high-quality technical support to employees across our organisation, primarily in Norway and Sweden.

Our Service Desk is more than a traditional first-line support function. We resolve approximately 80% of all incoming IT requests and incidents within the team, which means you will have the opportunity to work with a wide range of technical challenges, take ownership of issues and develop your troubleshooting skills.

You will work in an international environment where customer satisfaction, technical expertise and continuous improvement are key priorities. Our IT operations follow IT Service Management (ITSM) principles and ITIL practices, with a strong focus on efficient problem-solving, knowledge sharing and improving the employee IT experience.
Your responsibilities
As an IT Service Desk Technician, your main responsibilities will include:

• 
Deliver high-quality IT support: Provide professional, friendly and solution-oriented technical support to employees through phone, email and other support channels.

• 
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues: Investigate and resolve incidents involving computers, operating systems, applications, user accounts, access and other workplace technologies.

• 
Own incidents and service requests: Register, prioritise, investigate, document and follow up on cases in our ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Halo), taking responsibility for driving issues towards resolution.

• 
Ensure a great user experience: Communicate clearly with users, provide regular updates and manage expectations throughout the support process.

• 
Drive efficient resolution and knowledge sharing: Contribute to our high resolution rate by developing technical knowledge, documenting solutions and supporting a shift-left approach.

• 
Collaborate and continuously improve: Work closely with colleagues and other IT teams to resolve complex issues and improve processes related to Incident, Problem, Change and Knowledge Management.

• 
Manage IT equipment and suppliers: Support ordering, inventory management and distribution of IT equipment and accessories, including coordination with external suppliers.
What we're looking for
We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, takes ownership of problems and genuinely likes helping people.

You are curious about technology, comfortable investigating unfamiliar issues and motivated by finding solutions rather than simply passing problems on to someone else.

You enjoy working in an environment where priorities can change quickly and where teamwork, knowledge sharing and customer satisfaction are essential.
Skills and knowledge
To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

• 
A good understanding of computers, operating systems, software and common workplace IT technologies.

• 
The ability to troubleshoot technical issues in a structured and logical way.

• 
Familiarity with, or an interest in learning, technologies such as Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID.

• 
An understanding of the importance of documenting incidents, solutions and technical information.

• 
The ability to communicate technical information clearly to users with different levels of IT knowledge.

• 
Professional proficiency in Norwegian or Swedish, as well as English, both written and spoken.
Nice to have
The following qualifications are an advantage, but not essential:

• 
Previous experience working in an IT Service Desk, IT Support or similar technical support role.

• 
Around two years of relevant technical experience or education.

• 
Experience working with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or Halo.

• 
Knowledge of ITIL principles and IT Service Management processes.

• 
Relevant IT certifications or technical training.

• 
Experience with IT equipment management, inventory control or supplier coordination.

• 
Experience with AI tools and technologies, particularly using AI to improve IT support, automate tasks, enhance troubleshooting or streamline workflows.

We value practical skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn. You do not need to meet every preferred qualification to be considered for the role.
Who you are
We believe the following qualities will help you succeed:

• 
Customer oriented: You enjoy helping others, understand their needs and take pride in delivering excellent service.

• 
Problem-solving: You approach technical challenges with curiosity, persistence and a structured mindset, taking responsibility for finding solutions.

• 
Communication: You explain technical issues clearly, listen actively and keep users informed throughout the support process.

• 
Adaptable: You are comfortable handling changing priorities, learning new technologies and working in a dynamic IT environment.

• 
Collaborative: You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to a positive and supportive team environment.
Why join us?
You will join a Service Desk team in Oslo where technical problem-solving, collaboration and high-quality service go hand in hand.

Unlike traditional first-line support roles, our team handles and resolves the majority of incoming IT issues, giving you the opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies and technical challenges.

You will support colleagues across Norway and Sweden, work with modern workplace technologies and contribute to continuously improving how IT services are delivered.

We believe great IT support is about more than fixing technical problems. It is about taking ownership, building trust and making people's working lives easier.
